original_query: select min(i_item_id),         min(ca_country),         min(ca_state),         min(ca_county),         min(cs_quantity),         min(cs_list_price),         min(cs_coupon_amt),         min(cs_sales_price),         min(cs_net_profit),         min(c_birth_year),         min(cd_dep_count)  from catalog_sales, customer_demographics, customer, customer_address, date_dim, item  where cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and        cs_item_sk = i_item_sk and        cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk and        cs_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and        cd_gender = 'F' and        cd_education_status = 'College' and        c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and        d_year = 2001 and        c_birth_month = 5 and        ca_state in ('MT', 'OH', 'OR')        and cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 84 AND 89        AND i_category = 'Jewelry' ;
rewritten_query:
SELECT min(i_item_id),
       min(ca_country),
       min(ca_state),
       min(ca_county),
       min(cs_quantity),
       min(cs_list_price),
       min(cs_coupon_amt),
       min(cs_sales_price),
       min(cs_net_profit),
       min(c_birth_year),
       min(cd_dep_count)
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
WHERE cd.cd_gender = 'F'
  AND cd.cd_education_status = 'College'
  AND d.d_year = 2001
  AND c.c_birth_month = 5
  AND ca.ca_state IN ('MT', 'OH', 'OR')
  AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 84 AND 89
  AND i.i_category = 'Jewelry';

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Convert implicit comma joins into explicit ANSI INNER JOINs with table aliases, improving readability while keeping identical semantics and the same execution plan.

All local predicates (cd_gender, cd_education_status, d_year, c_birth_month, ca_state IN, cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN, i_category) are already sargable and can be pushed down by the optimizer; no further simplification needed.
No CTEs or subquery rewrites are beneficial: each table is referenced exactly once, so CTE materialization would only add overhead. The flat join structure is optimal.
